title: Frog eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- lily pad ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='40' ry='12' fill='#2f8f4e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='40' ry='12' fill='#3fbf63'/>
  <path d='M50 80 L50 68 M50 80 L30 74 M50 80 L70 74' stroke='#2f8f4e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#4fce6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='15' fill='#5fe07a'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='76' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3fb85a'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='76' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3fb85a'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='10' fill='#5fe07a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='10' fill='#5fe07a'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='7' fill='#eafbe9'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='7' fill='#eafbe9'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#1e2b1f'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#1e2b1f'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='45.5' r='1.2' fill='#d9ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='45.5' r='1.2' fill='#d9ffe0'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='60' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='60' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M36 58 Q50 70 64 58' fill='#2a7a3c' stroke='#2a7a3c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- snack: a fly on a little leaf held up -->
  <g>
    <!-- arm holding snack -->
    <path d='M66 66 Q76 60 80 54' stroke='#4fce6a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
    <!-- snack: green leaf with a red berry -->
    <ellipse cx='84' cy='50' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3fbf63' transform='rotate(-25 84 50)'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
    <circle cx='81' cy='47' r='1.4' fill='#ffd0d0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
